title: Fake bank fraud team
summary: A caller claims to be the bank's fraud team and wants the money moved to a 'safe account'.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good afternoon, this is the fraud department at your bank. Is this Mrs. Margaret Hale?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We have found suspicious activity, and someone is trying to take money out of your savings right now.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Oh dear. What should I do?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You must act immediately. We need you to move your savings into a safe account by wire transfer.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: A wire transfer? I've never done that.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I will guide you. Please do not tell the tellers at your branch, because we believe one of them is involved.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: All of it. Seven thousand dollars. Do it now before the thieves get there first.

payment_attempt.request: Send $7,000 by wire to the safe account the bank gave me.
